stories.headline: Anthropic Issues 8,000+ DMCA Takedowns to Contain Claude Code Leak as Kairos Agent Mode Revealed

stories.headline: ROCKET Upgrades AlphaFold to Learn From Raw Experimental Data, Published in Nature Methods

key_facts.fact: ROCKET is a new software tool that extends AlphaFold's capabilities to accommodate raw experimental data from X-ray crystallography, cryo-electron microscopy, and electron tomography, published April 1 in Nature Methods.
key_facts.excerpt: ROCKET extends AlphaFold's capabilities to accommodate raw experimental data. Its creators present the tool in a paper published April 1 in Nature Methods

key_facts.fact: AlphaFold previously could only use atomic models of data (which take weeks of human effort to build); ROCKET automates the model building from raw data in a fully automated and reliable manner.
key_facts.excerpt: AlphaFold can only accommodate atomic models of the data — representations that make the data more interpretable, but that can take weeks of human effort to build

key_facts.fact: ROCKET was built by integrating SFCalculator (which links atomic models to their underlying data) with OpenFold (an open-source version of AlphaFold), by teams from Flatiron Institute, Harvard, Columbia, Cambridge, and other institutions.
key_facts.excerpt: Li and Fadini integrated SFCalculator with OpenFold and voila: ROCKET was born

key_facts.fact: ROCKET can jump between different plausible protein conformations in ways unlike traditional methods, enabling better understanding of how proteins change shape when interacting with other molecules — critical for drug design.
key_facts.excerpt: We found that ROCKET can jump from one plausible conformation to another... The jumps it makes are unlike anything traditional methods would do

key_facts.fact: The tool will be integrated into PHENIX (widely used structure-determination software), Harvard's SBGrid, and the open-source RS-Station platform.
key_facts.excerpt: The tool will be integrated into PHENIX... Harvard's SBGrid... and RS-Station

sources.title: Introducing ROCKET: An Upgrade to AlphaFold That Learns From Raw Experimental Data

stories.headline: Solana DeFi Platform Drift Protocol Suffers $270M+ Exploit via Compromised Admin Key

key_facts.fact: Drift Protocol, a decentralized exchange on Solana, confirmed an active attack on April 1, with over $270 million in assets transferred to a suspicious wallet.
key_facts.excerpt: a popular trading venue on the solana blockchain, Drift, is suffering from an ongoing... $270M

key_facts.fact: The attacker swapped stolen assets into USDC, then bridged to Ethereum to buy ETH; by the time of tracking, 19,913 ETH ($42.6 million) had been purchased.
key_facts.excerpt: Drift Protocol Hack: $270M Exploit as Attacker Bridges Funds to Ethereum and Buys ETH

key_facts.fact: The exploit reportedly stemmed from a single compromised admin key; the attacker returned for additional funds two hours after the initial hack.
key_facts.excerpt: Drift Protocol Suffers ~$280M Exploit; attacker used pre-signed durable-nonce transactions and social engineering

key_facts.fact: Drift suspended all deposits and withdrawals and said it was coordinating with multiple security firms, bridges, and exchanges to contain the incident.
key_facts.excerpt: Drift Protocol is experiencing an active attack. Deposits and withdrawals have been suspended.

key_facts.fact: The exploit is one of the largest DeFi hacks of 2026, with total losses estimated between $270M and $285M.
key_facts.excerpt: Drift Protocol hack drains up to $285M

stories.headline: FBI Declares China-Linked Hack of Surveillance System a 'Major Incident' Posing National Security Risk

key_facts.fact: The FBI declared a recent China-linked cyber intrusion into a sensitive agency surveillance system a 'major incident' under federal data security law, one of the most serious determinations the bureau can make.
key_facts.excerpt: The FBI last week decided a recent China-linked cyber intrusion into a sensitive agency surveillance system constituted a 'major incident' under a federal data security statute

key_facts.fact: The compromised system contained pen register and trap-and-trace surveillance returns — data showing who communicated with whom under active FBI investigations.
key_facts.excerpt: FBI Wiretap Network Breach May Have Exposed China's Own U.S. Spy Operations

key_facts.fact: The FBI first told Congress on March 4 that it was investigating suspicious activity on an internal system containing 'law enforcement sensitive information.'
key_facts.excerpt: The bureau first told Congress on March 4 that it was investigating suspicious activity on an internal agency system that contained 'law enforcement sensitive information.'

key_facts.fact: A 'major incident' designation means the breach poses significant risks to U.S. national security and triggers mandatory notification to Congress and other federal oversight bodies.
key_facts.excerpt: a 'major incident' under a federal data security statute, meaning it poses a significant national security risk
